```{r}

#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

```

```{r}
## Average bill length by species

# This table shows the average bill length for each penguin species.

penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    average_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#Penguin Plot 


ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm)) +
  geom_point()
```
